description: Lists all questions and answer options of the CRA (EU Cyber Resilience Act) scope questionnaire at once, without a result, for example so the user can prepare the answers before starting. Returns the questions, their options, the ruleset version and its verification date. To go through the check step by step and get the result: cra_scope_check.
name: cra_scope_questions
title: List the CRA scope-check questions
